record.question:
Rewrite the following sentences as directed:
(a) He thanked me. (change the speech)
(b) The milkman supplies milk. (change the voice)
(c) What a lovely flower! (change to assertive)
(d) Never tell a lie. (change to affirmative)
(e) She bought a house. The house is white. (change to simple sentence)
(f) We are sure of his honesty. (change to complex sentence)
(g) God is present everywhere. (substitute a word for ‘present everywhere’)
(h) Jack is the best student of his class. (use comparative degree)
(i) It was a glorious victory. (change to exclamatory form)
(j) The soldiers were brave. (give opposite of ‘brave’) (10×1=10)
